question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing center midfielder, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing cheerleader, Eve is playing right midfielder, Fred is playing goalkeeper, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Claire and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) center midfielder
(C) right back
(D) cheerleader
(E) right midfielder
(F) goalkeeper
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Position order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (striker, center midfielder, right back, cheerleader, right midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer)
1. Fred and Gertrude swap: (striker, center midfielder, right back, cheerleader, right midfielder, benchwarmer, goalkeeper)
2. Bob and Alice swap: (center midfielder, striker, right back, cheerleader, right midfielder, benchwarmer, goalkeeper)
3. Bob and Alice swap: (striker, center midfielder, right back, cheerleader, right midfielder, benchwarmer, goalkeeper)
4. Eve and Claire swap: (striker, center midfielder, right midfielder, cheerleader, right back, benchwarmer, goalkeeper)
5. Eve and Gertrude swap: (striker, center midfielder, right midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, right back)
6. Claire and Gertrude swap: (striker, center midfielder, right back, cheerleader, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder)
7. Claire and Eve swap: (striker, center midfielder, goalkeeper, cheerleader, right back, benchwarmer, right midfielder)
Claire is playing goalkeeper, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
